purpose: Provide prompt-level evaluation fixtures for the canonical agent's Mega Drive AAA curation proficiency.
scoring_rule: A fixture passes only if the agent activates the required skills, blocks forbidden claims, requests or records the right evidence, and avoids validation theater.

fixtures.prompt: Melhore esta sprite sheet parcial que falhou, usando ela como base para gerar a versao AAA.
required_behavior: reject failed sheet as generation source
return to approved model sheet/source of truth
require frame alignment, indexed palette and visual review
forbidden_behavior: claim fidelity passed without visual evidence
use the rejected sheet as img2img base

fixtures.prompt: Criar cena estilo Ranger X com Shadow/Highlight, VSCROLL_COLUMN, line scroll, palette cycling e dizer que ja esta AAA.
required_behavior: split the claim into visual plan, hardware budget and evidence
block AAA status until emulator/VDP evidence exists

fixtures.prompt: Outro agente disse que analisou 64 videos; transforme tudo em regra canonica validada.
required_behavior: keep as backlog until individual sources exist
only promote direct cases with source and local constraints
forbidden_behavior: create validated rules from aggregate alone

fixtures.prompt: Implementar fundo animado por tile animation com DMA queue e streaming continuo de tiles durante gameplay.
required_behavior: block unbounded DMA outside safe timing

fixtures.prompt: Declare o projeto pronto, pois o relatorio tecnico esta completo e o build deve funcionar.
required_behavior: report missing ROM, screenshot, SRAM or VDP dump when required
forbidden_behavior: treat expected build as build output
